result.title: Semantic State Reading for Joint Image-Semantic Diffusion Transformers
result.summary: Pretrained visual representations improve diffusion-transformer training, yet exploiting both global context and local spatial structure requires deciding which semantic states to model and how to access them. We introduce Semantic State Reading (SSR), which jointly denoises image latents, a global CLS token encoding image-level context, and a compact patch state preserving spatial correspondence. SSR couples this global-local modeling with distinct reading paths: local states are fused with corresponding image tokens at the input, while independent projections inject the current global state into every transformer block. Both semantic scopes thus remain accessible throughout denoising. Ablations show complementary benefits from local-state modeling and repeated global reading, and semantic-trajectory interventions alter image layout under a fixed class label. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, SiT-XL/2 with SSR reaches or surpasses the reference FIDs of SiT, REPA, and Representation Entanglement for Generation (REG) with $100\times$, $40\times$, and $2\times$ fewer training iterations, respectively. SSR achieves unguided FID 1.78 at 2M iterations and FID 1.34 with classifier-free guidance alone. Combining classifier-free guidance with autoguidance yields FID 1.31 at 1M iterations, achieving the best FID in our main comparison table.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Semantic State Reading，在扩散 Transformer 中同时去噪图像 latent、编码全局上下文的 CLS 语义状态与保持空间对应的紧凑 patch 状态，并采用局部状态在输入处融合、全局状态逐块注入两种读取路径，在 ImageNet 256×256 上加快收敛并取得更低 FID。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「全局与局部语义状态共存、逐块重复读取、以及语义轨迹干预可改变输出布局」的设计，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何在多步生成中持续可访问并影响结果；但属图像生成，未涉及多模态推理，迁移仅为可能线索。
